summary: HSBC Holdings plc filed a Form 6-K reporting the issuance of €750,000,000 (or equivalent) 6.061% Fixed Rate/Floating Rate Senior Unsecured Notes due 2035 under its existing indenture, as supplemented by a 41st supplemental indenture dated 11 September 2026. The notes were issued via an effective shelf registration on Form F-3, with listing intended on the New York Stock Exchange. This is a routine debt capital markets takedown and not a special situation. No equity terms, board recommendation, advisor, premium, or deal mechanics are stated. Watch for pricing/listing confirmation only.
